podcast.title: Founding and Physical Format Hegemony
podcast.body: Founded by Bernliner, the Victor company quickly established itself as a "mother absolute" in the realm of physical music formats, making pivotal contributions to the development of sound recording and early gramophones. Victor's influence grew further after its merger with RCA, collectively driving significant disc improvements until the mid-1970s. "luego fundaría la casa Victor, madre absoluta de los formatos físicos prácticamente."

srcs.episode: Especial Formatos que fracasaron: Formatos antiguos

podcast.title: Pioneering Record Company (Early 1900s)
podcast.body: Victor was one of the major record companies that established a nationwide network of retailers in the early 1900s, primarily through furniture stores, to sell their Edison cylinders and Berliner discs. "This connet-wide collection of retailers was established by the big record companies of the day, which were Victor and Edison."
